source.version: Public author manuscript, final article Analytical Chemistry 85(21), 10392–10398 (2013)
source.selection: Three experimental GISP rows, HP measurement count and oxygen-18 columns only. No weighted average, assigned IAEA value, oxygen-17 or 17O-excess rows.

data_level: Published calibrated laboratory means, NOT raw ion currents or individual replicate measurements. Measurement calendar dates are not specified in the table.
scale: VSMOW–SLAP, normalized using VSMOW2 and SLAP2

units.delta18O_permil: per mille relative difference of 18O/16O from VSMOW
units.high_precision_measurements: count of high-precision measurements, each already combining multiple individual readings

uncertainty.standard_error_of_mean: IRMS standard error of mean as reported by authors. Not the standard deviation of individual readings.
uncertainty.convolved_instrumental_precision_limit: OA-ICOS measured limit of instrumental precision convolved with reference-water uncertainty, as described in text and table caption. Not labelled as an IRMS standard error or a common confidence interval.
uncertainty.comparison: Different uncertainty definitions are preserved. No pooled uncertainty, weighted consensus or significance test is computed.

method_context.LSCE_and_JHU: Water fluorinated with CoF3 to O2, purified, measured by dual-inlet Thermo MAT 253 at m/z 32, 33, 34. This is different sample preparation from the CO2 equilibration explained in the main article.
method_context.Los_Gatos_Research: OA-ICOS optical measurement of water vapour.
method_context.independence: Separate sample preparations and instruments. IRMS and optical absorption use different physics but share VSMOW2 and SLAP2 calibration materials. GISP is a validation material.
